Commercial Operations Director
description:
About AnywhereNow

Founded in 2010 in The Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. With around 240 employees working from 22 different countries, we partner with over 2,000 leading enterprises, including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town, to deliver exceptional customer experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven insights.

Our commitment to innovation, customer focus, and accountability drives our success. Our portfolio includes Dialogue Cloud, Deepdesk (AI Agent Assist), and Tendfor, delivering cutting-edge capabilities across Microsoft Teams environments and enterprise CX platforms.

Position Summary

The Commercial Operations Director owns the commercial engine of the post-sale customer lifecycle, renewals, pricing, deal desk, invoicing, and order-to-cash for AnywhereNow’s SaaS portfolio. You’ll protect and grow contract value, safeguard margin, and convert earned revenue into cash, combining commercial leadership, negotiation strength, and operational rigour.

You’ll lead the renewals and revenue-operations function and personally manage and negotiate the most difficult, complex, and at-risk renewals, working across Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal to secure timely, profitable outcomes and a frictionless billing experience for customers. The role is deliberately designed to balance effectiveness, efficiency, and cost across the commercial operation.


Key Responsibilities

Renewals Management & Negotiation

• Own the end-to-end renewals process, forecasting, pipeline, administration, and on-time execution across the customer base

• Personally lead and negotiate difficult, complex, high-value, and at-risk renewals, including multi-year, escalated, and competitively contested deals

• Develop renewal playbooks, negotiation strategies, concession frameworks, and save plays to de-risk and retain at-risk accounts

• Partner with Customer Success and Sales to surface renewal risk early and maximise gross and net revenue retention

Pricing, Deal Desk & Commercial Governance

• Own pricing execution, discount governance, and the deal desk for non-standard and complex commercial terms

• Review and approve quotes, price uplifts, and contract terms to protect unit economics and gross margin

• Maintain price books, packaging, and approval matrices, and ensure compliance with commercial policy

• Provide commercial modelling and deal guidance on high-stakes negotiations

Billing, Invoicing & Order-to-Cash

• Own accurate, on-time sales invoicing and the full order-to-cash cycle

• Drive billing accuracy, revenue-recognition alignment with Finance, and clean contract-to-invoice hand-offs

• Reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and accelerate cash collection in partnership with Finance

• Resolve billing and pricing queries quickly to protect the customer experience

Revenue Processes, Systems & Data

• Establish a single source of truth for renewals, contract, and commercial data

• Deliver renewal, retention, pricing, and cash forecasts and reporting to leadership

• Continuously improve process efficiency, cycle times, and cost-to-serve

Retention & Cross-functional Alignment

• Translate customer sentiment and account-health signals into proactive renewal and pricing action

• Align Sales (hand-offs, expansion), Customer Success (adoption, advocacy), Finance (rev-rec, DSO), and Legal (terms) around commercial outcomes

• Feed pricing, churn, and win/loss insight back into commercial and product strategy

Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Lead, coach, and scale the Commercial Operations and renewals team

• Establish and own KPIs (renewal rate, GRR / NRR, DSO, invoice accuracy, and cycle time)

• Instil a disciplined, data-driven operating rhythm balanced for effectiveness, efficiency, and cost

• Escalate only the largest strategic renewals to the COO with a clear recommendation

Core Competencies

Negotiation & Renewals Expertise

• Proven ability to manage and negotiate difficult, complex, and at-risk renewals, consistently delivering profitable outcomes.
• Skilled in objection handling, concession strategy, and multi-stakeholder negotiations in high-pressure environments.
• Strong track record of protecting and expanding contract value throughout the renewal lifecycle.

Commercial & Financial Acumen

• Strong understanding of key SaaS metrics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, DSO, cost-to-serve, and gross margin.
• Expertise in pricing strategy, packaging, discounting, and deal economics.
• Ability to assess commercial decisions and clearly articulate their financial impact.

Revenue Operations & Systems

• Deep understanding of quote-to-cash and order-to-cash processes.
• Proficient in CRM, CPQ, billing, subscription management, and renewals platforms.
• Focused on process optimisation, automation, data integrity, and operational efficiency.

Customer-Centric Retention Mindset

• Balances commercial objectives with customer experience and long-term retention goals.
• Leverages customer health indicators and voice-of-customer insights to drive proactive commercial action.
• Champions a seamless billing and renewal experience as a core business objective.

Data-Driven Decision Making

• Uses forecasting, analytics, and reporting to inform renewal strategies, pricing decisions, and cash-flow optimisation.
• Comfortable with commercial modelling, business cases, and scenario analysis.

Stakeholder Management & Influencing Skills

• Communicates effectively with executive, commercial, finance, legal, and customer-facing

stakeholders.
• Builds alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to achieve shared commercial outcomes.
• Confident and credible presence in customer-facing negotiations and strategic discussions.

Leadership & Execution

• Proven experience leading commercial operations, revenue operations, or renewals teams.
• Demonstrates a strong delivery mindset with accountability for revenue growth and cash performance.
• Equally comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on execution levels.

Experience & Profile

• 8+ years in commercial operations, revenue operations, renewals, or senior account management within SaaS

• Demonstrable, hands-on track record negotiating difficult, high-value, and complex renewals and commercial terms

• Experience owning renewals, pricing / deal desk, and/or order-to-cash at scale

• Strong systems fluency (CRM, CPQ, billing / subscription platforms) and commercial modelling

• Experience leading and scaling teams in a mid-size (~€40m ARR) SaaS environment

• Commercially astute, numerate, and customer-oriented, with excellent negotiation and stakeholder skills

Success Indicators (First 12–24 Months)

• Renewal rate and gross / net revenue retention improved and predictable

• Difficult and at-risk renewals consistently secured or improved through structured negotiation

• Pricing and discount governance embedded, with margin protected on non-standard deals

• DSO reduced, and invoicing accuracy and timeliness improved

• Quote-to-cash automated, with commercial data trusted as a single source of truth

• A high-performing Commercial Operations function balanced for effectiveness, efficiency, and cost

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures, and guidelines at all times

• Protecting company, customer, and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or loss

• Using company systems, devices, and networks in a secure and compliant manner

• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches, or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team

• Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required

• Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action

title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Technical Strategy Development
location: Mountain View, California, United States | San Diego, California, United States
description:
The Tech Strategic Programs organization delivers for Intuit and Tech Strategy by transforming and driving how our 10,000-person Technology ecosystem operates to accelerate outcomes for our customers.  This high performing team works with senior leaders and partners across the company.  We focus on strategic planning, the operating rhythm, executive narratives, workforce programs, and developing portfolio insights to accelerate the delivery of the highest priority areas for growth and customer impact leveraging emerging technology.

 

We are looking for creative problem solvers with a bias for action, an ability to analyze and connect the dots between multitudinous  sources of data and information, and a strong desire to drive tangible business impact. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will work alongside executive leaders to construct and deliver board and C-level content. You will also have an opportunity to work across the broader Product, Marketing, Finance, and Business segment communities to help innovate and drive change in how we operate. This position requires strong strategic problem solving and communication skills, the ability to inﬂuence and develop productive partnerships at all levels of the organization, solid business and technical acumen and a strong understanding of Intuit’s mission and values.


Responsibilities


  • Orchestrate development of executive-level presentations and content to be used by the CTO  in board meetings, CEO Staff meetings, and other forums

  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, Marketing, Finance, Business segments) to outline data-driven strategic frameworks decisions, and actionable recommendations

  • Lead strategy projects / work streams and new initiatives end-to-end, with limited guidance, from initial hypotheses to recommendation to operationalization

  • Develop narratives that highlight the outcomes delivered across the Tech Ecosystem and their connection to strategy

  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the Tech Ecosystem and CTO staff to ensure that we are thinking holistically across multiple tech priorities and in line with our technology strategy.

  • Design and implement frameworks and operating models that accelerate decision making, sharing of best practices, and operational excellence at scale across tech.  


Qualifications


  • 7-10 years of relevant experience in delivering signiﬁcant strategic and operational impact across an organization

  • Strategy and operations experience at a high growth startup, management consulting experience or strategic/analytical roles at large companies is desired

  • Proven track record in leveraging data, developing insight-backed hypotheses and driving learning plans to build compelling business cases

  • Demonstrated business and technical acumen, preferably in a SaaS or platform technology company.

  • Ownership mindset with an ability to convert strategic plans into actions, drive projects to completion, and sweat the details to deliver the outcome

  • Experienced change management leader who is able to inﬂuence and build trust across a highly cross-functional organization (peers, executives and working teams) to accelerate outcomes

  • Excellent communicator with strong presentation skills and compelling storytelling abilities; feel very comfortable leading and facilitating workshops and monthly/quarterly business reviews with executives and teams

  • Highly self-motivated, thrives in ambiguity and able to manage multiple projects with little day to day direction

  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills with the capacity to build relationships with senior stakeholders and collaborate across with team members across varying levels

  • Ability to generate innovative insights, ideas, and opportunities that drive tangible business outcomes

  • FinTech and/or SaaS experience a plus, but not required


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
Mountain View $238,000 - $322,000
San Diego, CA $219,500- $297,000

description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Why this role, why now

12,000+ companies trust Perk with their travel and spend, and we've brought both together in one intelligent platform. Every booking, expense and invoice adds to a wealth of data at your fingertips, and now is the moment to enable teams to use this data intelligently to power better decisions, precise reporting, and to create cost and time savings for our customers. Come lead the team that makes all of this possible.

The Role

Data is at the core of Perk's innovation and the backbone of how we will evolve our products using new technology. As our VP of Data, you'll step into one of the most influential leadership roles in Builders (Data, Product, Design, Engineering) with a direct hand in shaping Perk's strategy and success, and we scale our multi product platform.

Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. This role also spans our core functions and drives the business, including Customer Care, Marketing, Finance, Revenue and People. You'll join a strong, talented team with a clear mandate to shape how we create exceptional products at Perk, using our proprietary data.

Across travel, spend, and events, Perk holds a wealth of data that touches every booking, expense, invoice and payment. Your opportunity is to reshape it so it powers smarter, more intelligent products that keep us on the cutting edge of what is possible.

This is a role for a data leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, scales high-performing organisations through senior leaders, and has the technical credibility to go deep when it matters. You'll join a top-notch leadership team where we elevate each other, build shared strategies and win together. You'll help define how we grow and make decisions, with accountability for data across the whole company.

Your team

You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do. They span seven crafts: Data Product Partners, Reporting Analytics, Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Governance. Together they power the work the business relies on every day, and they’re ready to take data to its next stage of scale with you.

Your missions

  1. Strategy and Roadmap. More than ever data informs everything we do and is core to the AI native products that we build. You’ll own the long term vision and strategy for data architecture, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI product integration. Work hand in hand with Product, Engineering and Platform teams across Perk to turn machine learning and advanced analytics into products customers love.

  2. Set the standard for trust. Own data governance, privacy and compliance, so security and regulatory requirements are built in from the start. Partner with our AI leadership to make sure the data behind every AI product is trusted, so everything we build earns customer confidence.

  3. Build a data platform we rely on. Run data infrastructure like a flagship product: governed, reliable, built for scale from day one. You own the budget and the build, buy and prioritisation calls.

  4. Lead with conviction. Unify the craft, standards and roadmap across teams so data speaks with one voice, and anticipates questions before they're asked. Be the data voice alongside Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Revenue and People.

  5. Grow leaders who grow the business. Coach your senior leaders, shape the operating model and org design, attract top talent, and build a culture of ownership, autonomy and measurable results.

What success looks like

  • Data is the foundation of products that know our customers and anticipate what they need: personalised experiences, smarter recommendations and proactive insights, so they get answers before they have to ask.

  • You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting.

  • Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success.

  • Lead and influence, partner with executive leaders to shape the questions and drive the decisions that matter most.

What you'll bring

  • Proven scale-up leadership. You've led data organisations in high-growth tech or SaaS, and you've built this muscle before.

  • Leader of leaders. You've scaled organisations of 40 or more through senior leaders, coached leaders of leaders and hired top talent.

  • Technical excellence and innovation. A data science background combined with analytics and data engineering, and the depth to push what's possible in any direction.

  • Executive leadership. You've owned a data strategy and budget at executive level, made the big build, buy and invest calls, and helped set company direction alongside senior leadership.

  • Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge.

  • Trust by design. Deep understanding of data privacy, governance and compliance, including GDPR.

  • Partnership at every level. Proven trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations, and the communication skills to influence at the most senior levels and drive alignment.

  • Big picture and fine detail. You move comfortably between company-level strategy and hands-on specifics.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Airwallex is scaling a global sanctions programme across multiple jurisdictions, payment rails, and regulatory expectations. You'll provide the second-line leadership, challenge, and transformation needed to keep the programme effective, defensible, and ready for what comes next.

  • Own and continuously elevate Airwallex’s global sanctions strategy, policy framework, and second-line governance across all operating jurisdictions, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, AUSTRAC, and local regimes.

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge of first-line customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations, setting global standards for investigative quality, threshold tuning, and risk-based decision-making.

  • Act as the global second-line escalation point for complex sanctions nexus determinations, potential hits, voluntary self-disclosures, asset freezing, and high-risk commercial deal approvals.

  • Partner with Data, Product, and Engineering to co-design and validate fuzzy logic, name and transaction screening algorithms, geographic blocking mechanisms, and AI/ML-driven alert reduction systems, ensuring model defensibility and explainability.

  • Lead the roadmap to modernise sanctions screening through AI-assisted workflows, graph analysis, automated detection, and real-time capabilities for cross-border payment rails.

  • Lead regulatory examinations, supervisory inquiries, and complex due diligence reviews from global banking partners, keeping systems and decision trails audit-ready by design.

  • Monitor geopolitical developments, sanctions evasion typologies, trade controls, and enforcement trends, translating changes into platform requirements ahead of regulatory deadlines.

  • Report sanctions programme health, residual risk, key performance indicators, and emerging risk trends to executive leadership, risk committees, and the board.

  • Lead, inspire, and scale a high-performing team of sanctions managers and subject matter experts across multiple regions.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of dedicated experience in sanctions compliance and financial crime risk management.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs.   • Own the live view of energy availability risk and need: contracted, available, and committed energy and capacity at each site against planned load and ramp, by month and by hour where it matters; keep it current as deals sign, sites come online, and plans change, and close gaps and use surpluses with workload and site planning and energy origination.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. About our organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program. 

  • Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
  • Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
  • Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
  • Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
  • Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
  • Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in product management or product operations
  • Experience with developer platforms, API products, or payment systems

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.
